title: Kamera yang Hilang
description: Misteri pencarian kamera analog antik yang raib dari etalase pameran galeri seni kota tua, menginterogasi saksi mata, mendeskripsikan ciri-ciri orang mencurigakan, dan menarik kesimpulan inferensial logis.
learningFocus: Past Continuous for Events in Progress, Modal Verbs of Deduction ('must have been', 'could not have'), Physical Descriptions & Adjective Order, Reported Speech, Detective Vocabulary.

episodes.title: Pembukaan Pameran di Galeri Seni
episodes.titleEn: Opening Night at the Grand Gallery
episodes.recap: Sabtu malam di Old Town Art Gallery yang megah, kamu dan mentor Sarah menghadiri pameran fotografi internasional yang menampilkan kamera antik legendaris milik Elena Vance.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: Soft spotlight beams illuminate historic black-and-white photographs displayed along the high brick gallery walls.
dialogue.idText: Sorot lampu lembut menyinari foto-foto hitam-putih bersejarah yang dipajang di sepanjang dinding bata tinggi galeri.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Look at the center glass display case! That is Elena Vance's original 1954 analog camera, valued at over fifty thousand dollars.
dialogue.idText: Lihat etalase kaca di tengah ruangan! Itu kamera analog asli tahun 1954 milik Elena Vance, bernilai lebih dari lima puluh ribu dolar.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Kamera itu memiliki bodi logam krom dan lensa kristal yang sangat indah! Fotografer legendaris Elena Vance sedang diwawancarai wartawan!
dialogue.idText: Kamera itu memiliki bodi logam krom dan lensa kristal yang sangat indah! Fotografer legendaris Elena Vance sedang diwawancarai wartawan!

dialogue.prompt: Julian Croft, kurator galeri seni berjas beludru merah marun, menyapa kalian di dekat etalase utama. Apa tanggapanmu?

options.text: Good evening Mr. Croft! The lighting and presentation of this vintage camera exhibition are truly magnificent.
options.reactionEn: Thank you so much! This exhibition honors sixty years of master photography. The camera inside this locked glass case has captured world history.
options.reactionId: Terima kasih banyak! Pameran ini menghormati enam puluh tahun mahakarya fotografi. Kamera di dalam etalase kaca terkunci ini telah mengabadikan sejarah dunia.

options.text: Could you tell us about the roll of film currently loaded inside the historic camera?
options.reactionEn: It contains Elena's unpublished final negatives from her Sahara expedition. They are completely irreplaceable!
options.reactionId: Kamera itu memuat klise negatif terakhir Elena yang belum diterbitkan dari ekspedisi Sahara. Klise itu sama sekali tak tergantikan!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: An extraordinary piece of art history. The entire gallery crowd is captivated by its craftsmanship.
dialogue.idText: Karya sejarah seni yang luar biasa. Seluruh kerumunan pengunjung galeri terpikat oleh keindahan buatannya.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A room or building for the display or sale of works of art.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The historic art gallery hosts prestigious international exhibitions.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A public display of works of art or items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Hundreds of art collectors attended the opening night exhibition.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A device for recording visual images in the form of photographs, film, or video signals.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The vintage analog camera rested on velvet inside the glass box.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A person who takes photographs, especially as a job or profession.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Elena Vance is an internationally acclaimed documentary photographer.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Present or existing from the beginning; not a copy or imitation.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The original 1954 lens is preserved in mint condition.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An arrangement of items that may be viewed by the public.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The security lights focused directly on the central artifact display.

grammarFocus.title: Kata Sifat Deskriptif Karya Seni (*magnificent, vintage, unique, original*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan kata sifat bernilai tinggi saat mengapresiasi dan mendeskripsikan karya seni bernilai sejarah tinggi.

culturalTip.title: Malam Pembukaan Galeri Seni (*Vernissage / Opening Reception*)
culturalTip.content: Di dunia seni internasional, *opening night* (vernissage) dihadiri oleh seniman, kurator, jurnalis, dan kolektor dengan busana formal (*smart elegant*). Tamu berkeliling menikmati karya sambil berbincang santai (*mingling*).

quiz.question: Where is the prestigious photography exhibition taking place?
options: At the Old Town Art Gallery
On top of a commercial airport terminal
quiz.explanation: Pameran fotografi bergengsi berlangsung di Old Town Art Gallery.

quiz.question: Why is Elena Vance's 1954 analog camera considered irreplaceable?
options: It holds unpublished final negative rolls from her Sahara expedition
It is made entirely of edible candy
It belongs to a cartoon character
It was bought yesterday at a cheap grocery shop
quiz.explanation: Kamera tersebut memuat klise negatif terakhir yang belum diterbitkan dari ekspedisi Sahara.

quiz.question: Which noun refers to a public showcase of art held in a museum or gallery?
quiz.explanation: 'Exhibition' adalah pameran karya seni atau barang bersejarah di galeri atau museum.

quiz.question: Which adjective means 'not a copy or imitation; created directly by the artist'?
quiz.explanation: 'Original' bermakna asli, murni, dan bukan tiruan atau salinan.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'The master artifact was placed inside a secured glass ______ in the main hall.'
quiz.explanation: 'Display' (display case / etalase pajangan) adalah kata benda yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata galeri dan fotografi: gallery, exhibition, camera, photographer, original, display.
Menggunakan kata sifat apresiatif seni untuk mendeskripsikan artefak bersejarah.
Memahami atmosfer etis pada malam pembukaan pameran seni internasional.
episodes.cliffhanger: Tepat pukul 19.45 saat gelas sampanye diangkat untuk bersulang, seluruh lampu chandelier di langit-langit galeri tiba-tiba padam! Suara denting kaca pecah terdengar samar dalam kegelapan...

episodes.title: Lampu Padam dan Etalase yang Kosong
episodes.titleEn: The Blackout & The Empty Glass Case
episodes.recap: Pemadaman listrik mendadak selama tiga puluh detik memicu kepanikan singkat. Saat lampu darurat menyala, etalase kaca telah terbuka dan kamera antik raib tanpa jejak.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: Complete dark engulfs the grand hall. Gasps and urgent shouts ripple through the startled crowd of gallery guests.
dialogue.idText: Kegelapan pekat menyelimuti aula utama. Desah kaget dan teriakan panik beriak di antara kerumunan tamu galeri.

dialogue.speaker: Julian Croft
dialogue.en: Stay calm everyone! Security, activate the auxiliary emergency generator immediately!
dialogue.idText: Tetap tenang semuanya! Petugas keamanan, segera aktifkan generator darurat cadangan!

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Suara sirine alarm berdengung kencang! Lampu darurat kuning mulai menyala! Lihat ke arah meja tengah!
dialogue.idText: Suara sirine alarm berdengung kencang! Lampu darurat kuning mulai menyala! Lihat ke arah meja tengah!

dialogue.prompt: Lampu kuning redup menyorot etalase tengah. Apa yang kamu perhatikan di atas meja beludru?

options.text: The glass case has been unlocked and the velvet cushion is completely bare! The camera has disappeared!
options.reactionEn: My Leica! Someone took advantage of the sudden darkness to steal my life's work!
options.reactionId: Kamera Leicaku! Seseorang memanfaatkan kegelapan mendadak untuk mencuri karya hidupku!

options.text: Marcus, seal all the gallery exit doors immediately so nobody can leave with the artifact!
options.reactionEn: The security gates are locked automatically! Nobody has left through the front entrance yet.
options.reactionId: Pintu gerbang keamanan telah terkunci otomatis! Belum ada yang keluar lewat pintu depan.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: The high-pitched alarm is ringing. We must stay objective and examine the scene before evidence is contaminated.
dialogue.idText: Alarm bernada tinggi berdengung nyaring. Kita harus tetap objektif dan memeriksa lokasi kejadian sebelum barang bukti terkontaminasi.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A hard, brittle substance, typically transparent, used for windows, bottles, and display cases.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The protective glass lid of the case was lifted open.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To cease to be visible; vanish from sight unexpectedly.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The valuable artifact seemed to disappear within thirty seconds.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To utter a loud cry or call, typically as an expression of a strong emotion.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The curator began to shout for security as the lights went out.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A large number of people gathered together in a disorganized or unruly way.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: A stunned crowd gathered around the empty pedestal.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: With little or no light; in the absence of illumination.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The exhibition room turned completely dark during the power cut.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An anxious awareness of danger, or a warning sound signaling an emergency.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The gallery security alarm sounded throughout the complex.

grammarFocus.title: Past Continuous untuk Kejadian yang Terinterupsi (*While the crowd was mingling, the lights went out*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan Past Continuous (was/were + verb-ing) untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di latar belakang, dipotong oleh aksi mendadak berformat Simple Past (V2).
grammarFocus.formula: While + Subject + was/were + [Verb-ing], Subject + [Past Simple V2] / While the guests were admiring the photos, the room went dark.

culturalTip.title: Protokol 'Lockdown' Galeri Seni Internasional
culturalTip.content: Saat barang seni bernilai tinggi dilaporkan hilang, protokol standar museum (*Art Loss Register Protocol*) mewajibkan penguncian pintu otomatis (*lockdown*), pemeriksaan rekaman CCTV, dan pendataan identitas seluruh pengunjung yang hadir di lokasi.

quiz.question: What sudden event caused confusion inside the art gallery?
options: A complete electrical power blackout plunging the hall into dark
A sudden thunderstorm flooding the floor
An earthquake shaking the city bridge
A wild animal running through the reception
quiz.explanation: Pemadaman listrik mendadak membuat aula galeri gelap gulita.

quiz.question: What was discovered on the central pedestal when the emergency lights turned on?
options: A hot plate of vegetable noodles
The glass display case was open and the vintage camera had disappeared
quiz.explanation: Etalase kaca telah terbuka dan kamera antik telah raib tanpa jejak.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly pairs Past Continuous with an interrupting Simple Past action?
options: While the guests were chatting, the lights suddenly failed.
While guests chatting, lights will was dark.
Guests were chat when lights are off.
quiz.explanation: 'While the guests were chatting, the lights suddenly failed' adalah kombinasi Past Continuous dan Simple Past yang tepat.

quiz.question: Which verb means 'to cease to be visible or vanish from sight unexpectedly'?
quiz.explanation: 'Disappear' berarti lenyap atau menghilang dari pandangan secara tak terduga.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'The piercing sound of the security ______ warned everyone to stay inside the building.'
quiz.explanation: 'Alarm' (sirine alarm) adalah kata benda yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata situasi darurat galeri: glass, disappear, shout, crowd, dark, alarm.
Menguasai pola kalimat Past Continuous saat menceritakan kronologi peristiwa tak terduga.
Memahami prosedur pengamanan ketat (*lockdown*) saat terjadi insiden di galeri seni.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kamu berjongkok di samping etalase kaca yang terbuka. Di atas kain beludru merah, tergeletak sebuah petunjuk ganjil yang ditinggalkan pelaku...

episodes.title: Memeriksa Tempat Kejadian Perkara
episodes.recap: Dengan cermat dan penuh kehati-hatian, kamu mengamati etalase pameran untuk mencari barang bukti fisik dan petunjuk forensik yang tertinggal.

dialogue.speaker: Julian Croft
dialogue.en: The brass padlock was not forced open! The thief must have used a duplicate key or picked the lock skillfully.
dialogue.idText: Gembok kuningan tidak dirusak paksa! Pencuri pasti menggunakan kunci duplikat atau membobol gembok dengan sangat terampil.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Gunakan kaca pembesarmu! Lihat serat kain abu-abu gelap yang tersangkut di sudut engsel logam etalase!
dialogue.idText: Gunakan kaca pembesarmu! Lihat serat kain abu-abu gelap yang tersangkut di sudut engsel logam etalase!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: There is also a faint smudge mark on the glass corner. We must be very careful not to smudge any evidence.
dialogue.idText: Ada juga bekas noda samar di sudut kaca. Kita harus sangat berhati-hati agar tidak merusak barang bukti.

dialogue.prompt: Sarah mengambil pinset forensik kecil dari tasnya. Bagaimana caramu mengamankan barang bukti tersebut?

options.text: Let us collect the wool fiber clue into a clean envelope and investigate who was wearing a charcoal wool coat.
options.reactionEn: Smart thinking! A charcoal wool overcoat is distinctive. Let's document this evidence immediately.
options.reactionId: Pemikiran cerdas! Mantel wol abu-abu arang sangat khas. Mari catat barang bukti ini segera.

options.text: Look at the lock mechanism: there is a tiny drop of fresh machine oil. The thief prepared this beforehand!
options.reactionEn: You are right! The lock was oiled in advance to open noiselessly in the dark.
options.reactionId: Kamu benar! Gemboknya telah diberi minyak pelumas sebelumnya agar terbuka tanpa suara dalam gelap.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Every clue tells a story. This theft was premeditated, but the thief left critical evidence behind.
dialogue.idText: Setiap petunjuk mengisahkan sebuah cerita. Pencurian ini direncanakan matang, namun pelaku meninggalkan bukti krusial.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A piece of evidence or information used in the detection of a crime or solving of a mystery.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The gray wool thread provided an essential investigative clue.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts of an incident.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Security officers investigate how the display case was opened.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A mechanism for keeping a door, lid, or container fastened.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The brass lock showed no signs of violent breakage.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Handle all physical evidence with protective cotton gloves.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or harm; cautious.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Be extremely careful when inspecting the crime scene perimeter.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A visible trace or impression, such as a spot, stain, or scratch on a surface.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: A distinct smudge mark was visible near the hinge.

grammarFocus.title: Modal Verbs Deduksi Masa Lampau (*must have used, could not have opened*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan modal of deduction lampau (must have + V3) untuk menyatakan kesimpulan yang hampir pasti terjadi berdasarkan bukti logis, dan (could not have + V3) untuk menyatakan ketidakmungkinan.
grammarFocus.formula: Subject + must have / could not have + [Past Participle V3] / The thief must have prepared a duplicate key.

culturalTip.title: Pelestarian Tempat Kejadian Perkara (*Preserving the Scene*)
culturalTip.content: Di dunia investigasi profesional, aturan pertama adalah *'Do not touch anything with bare hands'*. Jejak sidik jari dan serat kain (*fiber analysis*) adalah bukti mikroskopis yang paling rentan rusak bila tersentuh.

quiz.question: What physical clue was discovered caught on the metal hinge of the display case?
options: A strand of dark gray wool fiber
quiz.explanation: Serat kain wol abu-abu gelap ditemukan tersangkut di engsel etalase kaca.

quiz.question: Why did Julian Croft deduce that the lock was not forced open violently?
options: The glass was shattered with a hammer
The brass lock mechanism was completely intact without scratch marks
The lock was made of chocolate
The door was wide open all day
quiz.explanation: Gembok kuningan utuh tanpa bekas congkelan paksa, menandakan penggunaan kunci khusus.

quiz.question: Which modal phrase correctly expresses a logical deduction about the past?
options: The perpetrator must have planned this in advance.
The perpetrator will was planning tomorrow.
The perpetrator can planning right now.
quiz.explanation: 'Must have planned' menyatakan deduksi logis masa lampau yang berbobot kepastian tinggi.

quiz.question: Which noun refers to facts or items indicating whether a crime has occurred?
quiz.explanation: 'Evidence' adalah barang bukti atau fakta yang membuktikan suatu peristiwa.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Investigators must be very ______ not to disturb fragile clues on the floor.'
quiz.explanation: 'Careful' (berhati-hati) adalah kata sifat yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata penyelidikan forensik: clue, investigate, lock, evidence, careful, mark.
Menggunakan modal verbs deduksi lampau (must have + V3) untuk menyusun hipotesis logis.
Menyadari pentingnya menjaga keaslian tempat kejadian perkara.
episodes.cliffhanger: Sarah menunjuk ke sudut plafon lorong: 'Kamera pengawas CCTV nomor empat menyorot langsung ke arah etalase tengah. Ayo kita temui petugas keamanan Marcus di ruang monitor!'...

episodes.title: Mewawancarai Petugas Keamanan CCTV
episodes.recap: Di ruang pengawas keamanan, petugas Marcus memutar ulang rekaman video CCTV beresolusi tinggi sebelum dan sesudah insiden pemadaman listrik.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.en: I was monitoring the cameras when the blackout hit. Every video screen on this wall went static for thirty seconds.
dialogue.idText: Saya sedang mengawasi kamera saat listrik padam. Setiap layar video di dinding ini mendadak mati statis selama tiga puluh detik.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: What about the backup footage recorded right before the blackout? Did you notice anyone acting suspiciously near the hall?
dialogue.idText: Bagaimana dengan rekaman cadangan tepat sebelum pemadaman? Apakah Anda melihat seseorang bersikap mencurigakan di dekat lorong?

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Perhatikan sudut kiri rekaman pada menit 19.43! Ada sosok yang mondar-mandir menatap jam tangan dan memeriksa gembok!
dialogue.idText: Perhatikan sudut kiri rekaman pada menit 19.43! Ada sosok yang mondar-mandir menatap jam tangan dan memeriksa gembok!

dialogue.prompt: Marcus memperlambat rekaman video digital frame demi frame. Apa yang kamu minta kepadanya?

options.text: Could you freeze the screen at 19:44 and zoom in on the person standing beside the hall pillar?
options.reactionEn: Enhancing the image now. The person is carrying a heavy brown leather messenger bag over their shoulder.
options.reactionId: Memperjelas gambar sekarang. Orang tersebut membawa tas selempang kulit cokelat tebal di pundaknya.

options.text: Who was the last official witness standing near the west corridor before the lights went out?
options.reactionEn: Clara, our courtyard cafe barista! She stepped in to deliver sparkling water right before the blackout.
options.reactionId: Clara, barista kafe pelataran kita! Dia baru saja masuk mengantarkan air soda tepat sebelum pemadaman.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: The timestamp proves the suspect moved toward the courtyard exit during the blackout. Let's speak to Clara next.
dialogue.idText: Cap waktu membuktikan pelaku bergerak menuju pintu keluar pelataran saat pemadaman. Mari kita temui Clara selanjutnya.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A person who keeps watch, especially a person whose job is to protect people or property.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The security guard monitored twenty camera angles simultaneously.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To observe and check the progress or quality of something over a period of time.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Guards continuously monitor all gallery corridors.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A flat panel or area on an electronic device on which images, data, or video are displayed.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The control room screen revealed critical video timestamps.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A large room or corridor in a building used for public gatherings, exhibitions, or passage.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Camera three covers the east exhibition hall.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A thing constituting a piece of evidence about the past; an audio or visual recording.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Check the digital video record from seven forty-five PM.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A person who sees an event, typically a crime or accident, take place.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: A key witness saw the individual hurrying toward the courtyard.

grammarFocus.title: Pertanyaan Investigatif Masa Lampau (*Where were you standing?, Did you see...?*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan kombinasi 'Where were you + verb-ing?' untuk menanyakan keberadaan saat insiden terjadi, dan 'Did you + base verb?' untuk mengonfirmasi tindakan spesifik.
grammarFocus.formula: What were you doing when [event]? / Did you notice anyone near the door?

culturalTip.title: Integritas Bukti Rekaman CCTV dalam Investigasi
culturalTip.content: Di bawah hukum internasional (*Chain of Custody*), rekaman video digital tidak boleh diubah atau diedit sembarangan. Waktu (*timestamp*) pada rekaman menjadi patokan mutlak menyusun garis waktu penyelidikan.

quiz.question: What happened to the security monitors during the thirty-second blackout?
options: They turned into color television cartoons
Every video screen went static without signal
They showed a live soccer match
They started playing upbeat classical music
quiz.explanation: Semua layar monitor mengalami gangguan statis tanpa sinyal selama 30 detik pemadaman.

quiz.question: What accessory was the suspicious individual carrying over their shoulder on the CCTV record?
options: A heavy brown leather messenger bag
quiz.explanation: Sosok mencurigakan membawa tas selempang kulit cokelat tebal di pundaknya.

quiz.question: Which question correctly asks about a person's activity during an incident?
options: Where were you standing when the alarm sounded?
Where did you standing yesterday will be?
Where you are stand when alarm?
quiz.explanation: 'Where were you standing when the alarm sounded?' adalah pertanyaan investigatif yang tepat secara tata bahasa.

quiz.question: Which noun refers to a person who sees an incident take place firsthand?
quiz.explanation: 'Witness' adalah saksi mata yang melihat langsung suatu peristiwa terjadi.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Security officers reviewed the digital video ______ to confirm the exact timeline.'
quiz.explanation: 'Record' (video record / rekaman video) adalah kata benda yang tepat.

takeaways: Mempelajari kosakata pengawasan keamanan: guard, monitor, screen, hall, record, witness.
Menyusun pertanyaan investigatif masa lampau untuk mewawancarai saksi.
Menghubungkan bukti rekaman visual dengan kronologi waktu kejadian.
episodes.cliffhanger: Di kafe sudut pelataran galeri, seorang barista muda bercelemek linen hijau sedang mengelap meja marmer sambil menatap cemas ke arah pintu gerbang...

episodes.title: Kesaksian Barista Kafe Galeri
episodes.titleEn: Witness Testimony from the Cafe Barista
episodes.recap: Clara, barista kafe pelataran, memberikan keterangan krusial mengenai seorang pelanggan yang tampak gugup dan bergegas pergi sesaat setelah lampu padam.

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: I was pouring a double espresso when the lights went out. A customer at the corner table immediately leaped up and hurried away.
dialogue.idText: Saya sedang menuangkan espresso ganda saat lampu padam. Seorang pelanggan di meja sudut langsung melompat berdiri dan bergegas pergi.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Can you describe what you remember about this customer's appearance and behavior, Clara?
dialogue.idText: Bisakah kamu mendeskripsikan apa yang kamu ingat tentang penampilan dan gerak-gerik pelanggan ini, Clara?

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Catat setiap detail fisik yang dia sebutkan! Bentuk wajah, pakaian, dan warna jaketnya sangat penting!
dialogue.idText: Catat setiap detail fisik yang dia sebutkan! Bentuk wajah, pakaian, dan warna jaketnya sangat penting!

dialogue.prompt: Clara mengingat pakaian khusus yang dikenakan orang tersebut. Pertanyaan apa yang kamu ajukan?

options.text: Did you mention earlier that he was wearing a heavy dark jacket and clutching a leather bag?
options.reactionEn: Yes! He wore a dark charcoal wool coat over a navy suit, and he held his leather bag tightly against his chest.
options.reactionId: Ya! Dia mengenakan mantel wol abu-abu arang di atas setelan jas biru tua, dan dia mendekap tas kulitnya erat-erat di dada.

options.text: Did he drop anything or say anything to you before hurrying toward the exit corridor?
options.reactionEn: He dropped a gallery admission ticket stub on the cafe floor! It has a printed seat number from the reception desk.
options.reactionId: Dia menjatuhkan sobekan tiket masuk galeri di lantai kafe! Ada nomor kursi tercetak dari meja resepsionis.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: That ticket stub is a vital breakthrough! We can match the printed number directly against the guest registry.
dialogue.idText: Sobekan tiket itu terobosan sangat penting! Kita bisa mencocokkan nomor cetak itu langsung dengan buku tamu pendaftaran.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To refer to something briefly and without going into detail.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The witness did not mention hearing any loud footsteps.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To give an account in words of someone or something, including all the relevant characteristics.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Please describe the suspect's height and clothing accurately.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To move or act with great speed or urgency.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The suspicious visitor seemed to hurry toward the side exit.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An outer garment extending either to the waist or the hips, typically having sleeves and a fastening down the front.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: He zipped up his dark wool jacket before leaving the counter.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A person or organization that buys goods or services from a store or other business.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The cafe barista remembered the customer who ordered espresso.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To have in or be able to bring to one's mind an awareness of someone or something from the past.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Can you remember what time the visitor left the cafe table?

grammarFocus.title: Reported Speech Dasar untuk Pernyataan Saksi (*She mentioned that he was wearing...*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan Reported Speech (kalimat tidak langsung) saat merangkum kesaksian para saksi: kata kerja pelapor 'stated / mentioned / explained' diikuti klausa dengan pergeseran tenses lampau.
grammarFocus.formula: Subject + mentioned/stated that + Subject + was/were + [Past verb/adj] / Clara stated that the customer hurried toward the door.

culturalTip.title: Metode Wawancara Saksi 'Cognitive Interview'
culturalTip.content: Dalam wawancara kepolisian modern, saksi tidak diarahkan dengan pertanyaan menjebak (*leading questions*). Penyelidik meminta saksi membayangkan kembali suasana panca indra (suara, pencahayaan, aroma) untuk memicu memori yang akurat.

quiz.question: What physical item did the hurried customer accidentally drop on the cafe floor?
quiz.explanation: Pelanggan tersebut tak sengaja menjatuhkan sobekan tiket masuk galeri di lantai kafe.

quiz.question: What was the customer holding tightly against his chest while hurrying away?
quiz.explanation: Pelanggan itu mendekap tas selempang kulit tebal erat-erat di dadanya.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses Reported Speech to summarize a witness statement?
options: Clara mentioned that the man was wearing a dark wool coat.
Clara say the man wear coat today.
Clara mentions that the man will was run.
Clara mentioned man is wearing tomorrow.
quiz.explanation: 'Clara mentioned that the man was wearing a dark wool coat' menggunakan Reported Speech dengan pergeseran lampau yang tepat.

quiz.question: Which verb means 'to give an account in words of someone's physical appearance'?
quiz.explanation: 'Describe' berarti mendeskripsikan atau menggambarkan ciri-ciri seseorang dengan kata-kata.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Try to ______ any distinctive details about his shoes or accessories.'
quiz.explanation: 'Remember' (mengingat) adalah kata kerja yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata keterangan saksi: mention, describe, hurry, jacket, customer, remember.
Menggunakan Reported Speech untuk merangkum pernyataan saksi secara objektif.
Memanfaatkan bukti fisik yang terjatuh (*ticket stub*) untuk mempersempit pencarian.
episodes.cliffhanger: Bersama Clara dan Marcus, kalian mengumpulkan seluruh ciri fisik pelaku untuk menyusun profil deskriptif terperinci sebelum memeriksa buku pendaftaran tamu...

episodes.title: Mendeskripsikan Ciri-Ciri Orang Mencurigakan
episodes.recap: Menyusun deskripsi fisik terperinci (tinggi badan, gaya rambut, pakaian luar, dan aksesori) membantu menyaring ratusan tamu pameran menjadi beberapa kandidat utama.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Let us assemble our suspect profile systematically: height, hair style, clothing, and carried accessories.
dialogue.idText: Mari kita susun profil terduga pelaku secara sistematis: tinggi badan, gaya rambut, pakaian, dan aksesori bawaan.

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.en: He was a tall man, about 185 centimeters, with dark curly hair and sharp eyeglasses.
dialogue.idText: Dia pria yang berpostur tinggi, sekitar 185 sentimeter, berambut ikal gelap dan berkacamata tajam.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Perhatikan urutan kata sifatnya! Di bahasa Inggris, ukuran mendahului bentuk dan warna rambut: 'tall with dark curly hair'!
dialogue.idText: Perhatikan urutan kata sifatnya! Di bahasa Inggris, ukuran mendahului bentuk dan warna rambut: 'tall with dark curly hair'!

dialogue.prompt: Bagaimana caramu merangkum deskripsi pakaian dan tas pelaku secara baku?

options.text: The suspect is a tall man with dark curly hair, wearing a long charcoal wool coat and carrying a brown leather bag.
options.reactionEn: Flawless adjective order! That precise description narrows our search to someone fitting this exact profile.
options.reactionId: Urutan kata sifat yang sempurna! Deskripsi presisi itu mempersempit pencarian kita pada orang dengan profil tepat ini.

options.text: Could the brown leather bag be an antique camera bag designed specifically to hold vintage Leica equipment?
options.reactionEn: Yes! Vintage camera collectors often carry padded leather messenger bags with brass buckles.
options.reactionId: Tepat! Kolektor kamera antik sering kali membawa tas selempang kulit berlapis bantalan dengan gesper kuningan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: We have our profile: tall, curly dark hair, heavy charcoal coat, and a leather bag. Now let's cross-check the guest book.
dialogue.idText: Kita punya profilnya: tinggi, rambut ikal gelap, mantel abu-abu tebal, dan tas kulit. Sekarang mari periksa buku tamu.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Of great or more than average height, especially of a person.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The suspect was a tall gentleman standing by the archway.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Made of curls or having curls; waving or spiral in shape.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The witness clearly observed dark curly hair under the hat.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Any of the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: His distinctive curly hair helped identify him on CCTV.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An outer garment with sleeves, worn outdoors for warmth or protection.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: He wore a heavy charcoal wool coat on that autumn evening.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The antique camera was housed in a padded leather bag.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying items.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The leather bag was large enough to conceal the analog camera.

grammarFocus.title: Susunan Kata Sifat Deskripsi Fisik & Busana (*opinion + size + age + color + material + noun*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris, susunan kata sifat mengikuti aturan baku: Size/Length (tall/long) -> Shape/Texture (curly) -> Color (dark/charcoal) -> Material (wool/leather) -> Noun. Contoh: 'a long charcoal wool coat'.
grammarFocus.formula: [Size/Shape] + [Color] + [Material] + [Noun] / A handsome tall man wearing a heavy dark leather coat.

culturalTip.title: Akurasi Deskripsi Fisik dalam Penyelidikan Kriminal
culturalTip.content: Penyelidik profesional menghindari asumsi subjektif (seperti *'he looked evil'*). Deskripsi yang dapat diverifikasi secara ilmiah mencakup tinggi estimasi (*estimated height*), warna pakaian (*clothing color*), dan benda yang dibawa (*carried belongings*).

quiz.question: What physical features describe the suspect according to Clara and the CCTV footage?
options: A short boy with blonde hair and red sneakers
A tall man with dark curly hair wearing a charcoal wool coat
An elderly lady carrying an umbrella
A clown wearing a yellow hat
quiz.explanation: Profil pelaku adalah pria berpostur tinggi dengan rambut ikal gelap mengenakan mantel wol abu-abu arang.

quiz.question: Which phrase follows the correct grammatical order of adjectives?
quiz.explanation: 'A long charcoal wool coat' mengikuti urutan Size (long) -> Color (charcoal) -> Material (wool) -> Noun (coat).

quiz.question: Which material was used to manufacture the suspect's padded camera messenger bag?
quiz.explanation: Tas selempang tersebut terbuat dari bahan kulit (leather).

quiz.question: Which adjective means 'having curls or spiral waves' when describing human hair?
quiz.explanation: 'Curly' bermakna berombak, ikal, atau bergelombang pada rambut.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'He wore a stylish brown ______ bag across his chest.'
quiz.explanation: 'Leather' (kulit) adalah kata benda atributif yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata deskripsi ciri fisik: tall, curly, hair, coat, leather, bag.
Menguasai formula urutan kata sifat (adjective order) dalam bahasa Inggris.
Menyusun profil terduga pelaku secara sistematis dan objektif.
episodes.cliffhanger: Julian Croft membawa buku pendaftaran tamu VIP dari meja resepsionis depan: 'Nomor pada sobekan tiket kafe adalah 042. Mari kita buka halaman pendaftarannya!'...

episodes.title: Mencocokkan Buku Tamu dan Tiket Masuk
episodes.recap: Membandingkan nomor tiket masuk yang terjatuh di kafe dengan daftar hadir registrasi membuka fakta mengejutkan mengenai identitas pemegang tiket nomor 042.

dialogue.speaker: Julian Croft
dialogue.en: Here is the master registry list. Ticket 042 was registered under the name 'Dr. Arthur Sterling', an antique collector.
dialogue.idText: Ini daftar registrasi utama. Tiket 042 terdaftar atas nama 'Dr. Arthur Sterling', seorang kolektor barang antik.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Let us check his arrival timestamp. He checked in at 18:50 and matched Clara's physical description perfectly.
dialogue.idText: Mari kita periksa cap waktu kedatangannya. Dia check-in pukul 18.50 dan sangat cocok dengan deskripsi fisik Clara.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Tapi tunggu! Bandingkan tanda tangannya di buku tamu dengan tanda tangan di kartu anggota museumnya!
dialogue.idText: Tapi tunggu! Bandingkan tanda tangannya di buku tamu dengan tanda tangan di kartu anggota museumnya!

dialogue.prompt: Kamu membandingkan catatan registrasi dan rekaman CCTV pintu keluar. Apa yang kamu simpulkan?

options.text: The security turnstiles show Dr. Sterling never exited through the front gates! He must still be inside this building.
options.reactionEn: Heavens, you are right! The front doors were locked before he could leave. He is trapped inside the gallery!
options.reactionId: Astaga, kamu benar! Pintu depan terkunci sebelum dia sempat keluar. Dia terjebak di dalam galeri!

options.text: Look at the false signature on the registry: he wrote in a hurry and misspelled his own title as 'Collector'.
options.reactionEn: Sharp observation! That nervousness indicates he was under immense pressure.
options.reactionId: Pengamatan yang sangat tajam! Kegugupan itu menandakan dia berada di bawah tekanan besar.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Since he cannot exit through the front, where in this historic building could someone hide a vintage camera?
dialogue.idText: Karena dia tidak bisa keluar lewat pintu depan, di bagian mana gedung bersejarah ini seseorang bisa menyembunyikan kamera antik?

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A number of connected items or names written or printed consecutively, typically one below the other.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Check ticket number 042 on the VIP attendee list.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To correspond or cause to correspond in some essential respect; be equal.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The suspect's coat color matches Clara's description.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A piece of paper or card that gives the holder a certain right, especially of entry.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The numbered admission ticket was issued at the reception desk.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Not according with truth or fact; incorrect or deceptive.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The nervous registrant gave a false telephone number.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To estimate, measure, or note the similarity or dissimilarity between things.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Compare the registry signature with past museum archives.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Please check all turnstile exit logs from the past hour.

grammarFocus.title: Konjungsi Kontras & Waktu dalam Rekonstruksi (*although, whereas, since*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan kata hubung logis untuk menghubungkan premis dan kesimpulan penyelidikan: 'Since he could not exit...' (karena ia tak bisa keluar), 'Although the alarm sounded...' (meskipun alarm berbunyi).
grammarFocus.formula: Since + [Clause 1], [Subject] + must + [Base verb] / Since the front gate was locked, the suspect must still be inside.

culturalTip.title: Sistem Registrasi Tiket 'Digital vs Paper Registry'
culturalTip.content: Di acara lelang dan ekshibisi bernilai tinggi, setiap tiket memiliki nomor seri unik yang terikat pada data paspor atau kartu identitas resmi untuk mencegah aksi kejahatan seni (*art crime*).

quiz.question: Under what name was ticket number 042 registered in the guest book?
options: Dr. Arthur Sterling, an antique collector
quiz.explanation: Tiket 042 terdaftar atas nama Dr. Arthur Sterling, seorang kolektor barang antik.

quiz.question: What crucial fact did the turnstile security logs reveal about Dr. Sterling?
options: He never passed through the exit turnstiles and is still inside the building
He flew away in a hot air balloon
He was sleeping in the public library across town
He was singing on the roof
quiz.explanation: Catatan palang pintu otomatis membuktikan ia belum keluar dan masih berada di dalam gedung.

quiz.question: Which conjunction correctly connects the premise to the deduction?
options: Since the gates were locked, he must still be inside.
Where gates were locked, but inside.
quiz.explanation: 'Since the gates were locked, he must still be inside' menyusun relasi sebab-akibat deduktif yang sempurna.

quiz.question: Which verb means 'to note the similarity or dissimilarity between two items'?
quiz.explanation: 'Compare' berarti membandingkan dua hal untuk melihat persamaan atau perbedaannya.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Please ______ the guest attendance list to verify the registrant.'
quiz.explanation: 'Check' (memeriksa) adalah kata kerja yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata verifikasi data: list, match, ticket, false, compare, check.
Menggunakan konjungsi logis (since, although) untuk menarik simpulan tempat.
Memverifikasi data log keamanan otomatis untuk membuktikan keberadaan terduga pelaku.
episodes.cliffhanger: Julian Croft berseru pelan: 'Hanya ada satu tempat di gedung ini yang memiliki pintu keluar darurat tua tanpa sensor digital: Ruang Restorasi Lukisan Kuno di lantai bawah tanah!'...

episodes.title: Jejak Kaki Menuju Ruang Restorasi
episodes.titleEn: Footprints Leading to the Restoration Room
episodes.recap: Mengikuti jejak debu di lantai tangga batu mengarahkan penyelidikan menuju ruang restorasi lukisan yang sunyi di bawah tanah galeri.

dialogue.speaker: Narator
dialogue.en: A narrow spiral stone staircase descends beneath the gallery into a quiet, dimly lit vaulted corridor.
dialogue.idText: Tangga batu melingkar sempit menurun ke bawah galeri menuju koridor berkubah sunyi dengan penerangan redup.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Arahkan sentermu ke lantai batu kapur! Ada jejak tapak sepatu kulit baru yang tercetak di atas debu tipis!
dialogue.idText: Arahkan sentermu ke lantai batu kapur! Ada jejak tapak sepatu kulit baru yang tercetak di atas debu tipis!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Each step leads directly along this quiet floor toward the heavy iron-bound oak door marked 'Restoration Studio'.
dialogue.idText: Setiap langkah mengarah lurus di sepanjang lantai yang sunyi ini menuju pintu oak berpaku besi bertuliskan 'Studio Restorasi'.

dialogue.prompt: Pintu studio restorasi sedikit merenggang dan lampu pijar kuning menyala di dalam. Apa yang kamu lakukan?

options.text: Let us follow the track quietly and push the door gently without making any creaking noise.
options.reactionEn: Stealthy approach! Marcus and I will flank the entrance while you peer through the opening.
options.reactionId: Pendekatan senyap! Marcus dan saya akan berjaga di samping pintu saat kamu mengintip lewat celah.

options.text: Marcus, keep your flashlight ready on the door handle in case the suspect attempts to bolt.
options.reactionEn: Flashlight trained on the door! There is nowhere for him to run from this room.
options.reactionId: Senter terarah ke pintu! Tidak ada celah baginya untuk kabur dari ruangan ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: The footsteps stop right beside the wooden storage cabinets. Someone is breathing nervously inside.
dialogue.idText: Jejak langkah kaki berhenti tepat di samping lemari penyimpanan kayu. Seseorang bernapas dengan gugup di dalam.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A mark or marks left by a person, animal, or vehicle in passing.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The dusty footprints formed a clear track along the basement hall.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in walking; a stair tread.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Take each step down the spiral staircase carefully.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A hinged, sliding, or revolving barrier at the entrance to a room or building.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The heavy wooden door stood slightly ajar.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The lower surface of a room, on which one may walk.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Fine limestone dust coated the restoration floor.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To go or come after a person or thing; track the course of.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Follow the footprints to discover where the suspect fled.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Making little or no noise; calm, serene, and undisturbed.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The subterranean studio was completely quiet and eerie.

grammarFocus.title: Preposisi Gerakan & Arah (*down the stairs, along the hall, toward the door*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan preposisi gerak terarah untuk mendeskripsikan pengejaran fisik: 'down' (turun melewati), 'along' (menyusuri), 'through' (menembus), dan 'toward' (mengarah ke).
grammarFocus.formula: Subject + walked/descended + [preposition] + [destination] / We followed the dusty footprints down the stairs and toward the studio.

culturalTip.title: Ruang Restorasi Seni (*Conservation Studio*)
culturalTip.content: Di museum dan galeri bersejarah, ruang konservasi/restorasi biasanya terletak di lantai dasar atau bawah tanah dengan suhu dan kelembapan terkontrol ketat (*humidity-controlled environment*) untuk melindungi lukisan dan artefak rapuh.

quiz.question: Where did the dusty shoe footprints lead the investigators?
options: Down the spiral stone staircase to the quiet restoration studio
Out to the open street sidewalk
Onto the roof of the public bus
quiz.explanation: Jejak sepatu berdebu mengarah turun melewati tangga batu melingkar ke studio restorasi.

quiz.question: What preposition describes moving along the length of a corridor?
quiz.explanation: 'Along' berarti menyusuri sepanjang koridor.

quiz.question: Which adjective means 'making little or no noise; peaceful and undisturbed'?
quiz.explanation: 'Quiet' bermakna hening, tenang, dan tidak menimbulkan suara.

quiz.question: Which verb means 'to go or move behind someone by following their path'?
quiz.explanation: 'Follow' berarti mengikuti jalur atau jejak langkah seseorang.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'The heavy wooden ______ was standing open by a few inches.'
quiz.explanation: 'Door' (pintu kayu) adalah kata benda yang tepat.

takeaways: Mempelajari kosakata penelusuran fisik: track, step, door, floor, follow, quiet.
Menggunakan preposisi gerak (along, toward, down) untuk mendeskripsikan pelacakan.
Menerapkan kehati-hatian tinggi saat mendekati lokasi persembunyian terduga.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kamu mendorong pintu studio hingga terbuka lebar. Di balik meja restorasi lukisan, seorang pria jangkung bertubuh kurus sedang gemetar menatap tas kulit yang terbuka di atas meja...

episodes.title: Menemukan Tas yang Tertukar di Loker
episodes.titleEn: The Swapped Messenger Bag in the Locker
episodes.recap: Sebuah pengakuan mengejutkan terkuak: insiden ini bukan pencurian terencana kriminal, melainkan ketidaksengajaan dan tas yang tertukar dalam kepanikan gelap.

dialogue.speaker: Arthur Sterling
dialogue.en: Please don't call the police! I am not a thief! It was an absolute mistake in the dark!
dialogue.idText: Tolong jangan panggil polisi! Saya bukan pencuri! Ini benar-benar sebuah kekeliruan dalam kegelapan!

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Calm down, Dr. Sterling. Explain exactly what happened to Elena Vance's camera and why you are hiding here.
dialogue.idText: Tenanglah, Dr. Sterling. Jelaskan apa yang sebenarnya terjadi pada kamera Elena Vance dan mengapa Anda bersembunyi di sini.

dialogue.speaker: Arthur Sterling
dialogue.en: I bought an identical vintage Leica replica at the gift shop and placed it in my brown bag. When the blackout hit, the glass lid opened!
dialogue.idText: Saya membeli replika kamera Leica antik yang serupa di toko cinderamata dan menaruhnya di tas cokelat saya. Saat pemadaman terjadi, tutup kacanya terbuka!

dialogue.prompt: Dr. Sterling menunjuk kotak kayu penyimpanan di samping meja. Apa yang kamu temukan di dalamnya?

options.text: Let me open this wooden box: the original 1954 camera is nestled completely safe inside velvet cloth!
options.reactionEn: My camera! Not a single scratch on the lens, and the precious film roll is fully intact! What a tremendous relief!
options.reactionId: Kameraku! Tidak ada satu goresan pun pada lensa, dan rol film berharganya utuh sempurna! Sungguh kelegaan luar biasa!

options.text: You panicked because you thought you broke the display case and took the original by accident, didn't you?
options.reactionEn: Exactly! In the dark chaos, someone bumped me into the pedestal. I grabbed what I thought was my bag and fled in fear.
options.reactionId: Tepat sekali! Dalam kekacauan gelap, seseorang menubruk saya ke etalase. Saya menyambar apa yang saya kira tas saya dan kabur ketakutan.

dialogue.speaker: Julian Croft
dialogue.en: A colossal misunderstanding fueled by panic. What a massive relief to discover the priceless camera unharmed!
dialogue.idText: Sebuah kesalahpahaman raksasa yang dipicu oleh kepanikan. Sungguh kelegaan yang luar biasa menemukan kamera tak ternilai ini tanpa cedera!

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The precious camera rested securely inside a velvet-lined box.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: An action or judgment that is misguided or wrong.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The entire incident was caused by an honest mistake during the dark.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: Protected from or not exposed to danger or risk; not harmed.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Elena's original camera lens remained completely safe.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To be the property of someone.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The historic negatives belong to the renowned photographer.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To find unexpectedly or in the course of a search.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: We discover the intact camera hidden in the restoration cabinet.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: A feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Everyone sighed with immense relief upon seeing the intact camera.

grammarFocus.title: Past Perfect Tense untuk Peristiwa yang Terjadi Lebih Awal (*He had mistakenly picked up the bag*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan Past Perfect Tense (had + past participle V3) saat menjelaskan urutan kejadian lampau yang telah selesai sebelum aksi masa lalu lainnya terjadi.
grammarFocus.formula: Subject + had + [Past Participle V3] / Dr. Sterling had bought a replica before the blackout occurred.

culturalTip.title: Diferensiasi 'Theft vs Misplaced Mistake' dalam Hukum
culturalTip.content: Dalam hukum pidana internasional (*Mens Rea / Criminal Intent*), sebuah tindak pidana pencurian mensyaratkan adanya niat jahat terencana (*intention to permanently deprive*). Kejadian tertukar tanpa niat jahat diselesaikan secara administratif kekeluargaan.

quiz.question: What actually caused Dr. Arthur Sterling to take the historic Leica camera?
options: A professional heist ordered by art smugglers
An honest accident and panic caused by someone bumping him into the pedestal during the blackout
He wanted to sell it on the street for bus fare
He thought it was a toy flashlight
quiz.explanation: Penyebab sebenarnya adalah ketidaksengajaan dan kepanikan saat seseorang menubruknya ke etalase saat gelap.

quiz.question: In what condition was Elena Vance's original 1954 camera found?
options: Completely safe, undamaged, with its film roll intact
quiz.explanation: Kamera ditemukan dalam kondisi aman tanpa kerusakan sama sekali beserta rol filmnya.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses the Past Perfect tense to explain prior events?
options: He had purchased a replica before the lights failed.
He has purchase a replica when lights dark.
He will had purchasing a replica yesterday.
He having purchased a replica already.
quiz.explanation: 'He had purchased a replica before the lights failed' adalah konstruksi Past Perfect yang tepat (had + purchased).

quiz.question: Which word means 'a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following anxiety'?
quiz.explanation: 'Relief' adalah rasa lega yang dirasakan setelah ketakutan atau kekhawatiran mereda.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'The irreplaceable negative films ______ to Elena Vance's lifetime heritage.'
quiz.explanation: 'Belong' (milik/kepunyaan) adalah kata kerja yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata resolusi kesalahpahaman: box, mistake, safe, belong, discover, relief.
Menggunakan Past Perfect (had + V3) untuk menguraikan urutan kronologis kejadian masa lalu.
Mampu membedakan antara tindakan kriminal berencana dan kekeliruan akibat kepanikan.
episodes.cliffhanger: Elena Vance memeluk kameranya dengan mata berkaca-kaca penuh haru. Julian Croft menyalakan seluruh lampu aula galeri dan mengumumkan perayaan spesial untuk merayakan ditemukannya sang mahakarya...

episodes.title: Mengembalikan Kamera Bersejarah
episodes.titleEn: Restoring the Heirloom & The Victorious Toast
episodes.recap: Kamera bersejarah dikembalikan ke etalasenya di hadapan seluruh pengunjung galeri. Ketajaman analisis deduktifmu dipuji oleh kurator dan seniman dunia.

dialogue.speaker: Julian Croft
dialogue.en: Ladies and gentlemen, thanks to the brilliant deduction of our guest Alex, Elena Vance's legendary camera is safely returned!
dialogue.idText: Hadirin sekalian, berkat deduksi brilian dari tamu kita Alex, kamera legendaris Elena Vance telah dikembalikan dengan selamat!

dialogue.speaker: Elena Vance
dialogue.en: I cannot thank you enough, Alex. Your logical mind and calm observation saved sixty years of my visual truth and memory.
dialogue.idText: Saya tak henti-hentinya berterima kasih, Alex. Pikiran logis dan pengamatan tenangmu telah menyelamatkan enam puluh tahun kebenaran visual dan kenangan saya.

dialogue.speaker: Kanci
dialogue.en: Tepuk tangan meriah membahana untukmu! Dari detektif amatir hingga pahlawan pameran seni kota!
dialogue.idText: Tepuk tangan meriah membahana untukmu! Dari detektif amatir hingga pahlawan pameran seni kota!

dialogue.prompt: Elena Vance mengangkat gelasnya untuk bersulang menghormati keberhasilanmu. Apa responmu?

options.text: It is an immense honor to celebrate the truth with everyone tonight. Art and heritage belong to the whole world.
options.reactionEn: Hear, hear! To truth, art, and the brilliance of sharp minds! You deserve the highest praise.
options.reactionId: Setuju sekali! Demi kebenaran, seni, dan kecemerlangan pikiran yang tajam! Kamu layak menerima pujian tertinggi.

options.text: Thank you Elena! Teamwork with Sarah, Marcus, and Clara made this peaceful resolution possible.
options.reactionEn: Modest and brilliant as always! We are so proud of your exemplary problem-solving skills.
options.reactionId: Rendah hati dan brilian seperti biasa! Kami sangat bangga dengan keahlian pemecahan masalahmu yang patut dicontoh.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Solving this gallery mystery taught me that patience, logic, and empathy will always uncover the truth.
dialogue.idText: Memecahkan misteri galeri ini mengajarkanku bahwa kesabaran, logika, dan empati akan selalu menyingkap kebenaran.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To come or go back to a place or person; give, put, or send back.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: We return the vintage camera to its velvet pedestal.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To express gratitude to someone, especially by saying 'Thank you'.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Elena smiled warmly to thank the investigators.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: To acknowledge a significant or happy day or event with a social gathering or enjoyable activity.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: The entire gallery gathered to celebrate the safe recovery.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The quality or state of being true; that which is true or in accordance with fact or reality.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Careful deduction will always reveal the underlying truth.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: High respect or great esteem; a privilege that brings pride.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: It is a great honor to protect world-class cultural heritage.

highlightedVocab.enDefinition: The expression of approval or admiration for someone or something.
highlightedVocab.contextSentence: Alex received unanimous praise from artists and collectors alike.

grammarFocus.title: Ungkapan Apresiasi & Kesimpulan Deduksi (*Thanks to your sharp deduction..., It is an honor to...*)
grammarFocus.explanation: Gunakan frasa apresiasi formal berkelas tinggi saat menutup penyelesaian masalah besar: 'Thanks to + noun phrase', 'It is an immense honor to + base verb'.
grammarFocus.formula: Thanks to [Noun Phrase], [Result Clause] / It is an honor to celebrate this resolution.

culturalTip.title: Tradisi 'Toast of Honor' di Acara Budaya Mancanegara
culturalTip.content: Di jamuan resmi Eropa, tradisi bersulang (*toast of honor*) dipimpin oleh tokoh utama yang mengetuk gelas secara lembut, menyampaikan ucapan terima kasih singkat, dan disambut hadirin dengan seruan *'Hear, hear!'* atau *'Cheers!'*.

quiz.question: Who was publicly credited with solving the gallery camera mystery?
options: Alex, whose logical deduction uncovered the truth
A passing taxi driver on the avenue
A cartoon rabbit on the billboard
quiz.explanation: Alex dipuji di hadapan publik atas deduksi logisnya yang menyingkap kebenaran.

quiz.question: Which phrase is standard for expressing formal appreciation for team effort?
quiz.explanation: 'Thanks to your sharp deduction...' adalah ungkapan apresiasi formal yang baku.

quiz.question: Which noun refers to the state of being in accordance with fact or reality?
quiz.explanation: 'Truth' adalah kebenaran yang sesuai dengan fakta dan kenyataan.

quiz.question: Which verb means 'to give back something to its rightful owner or location'?
quiz.explanation: 'Return' berarti mengembalikan sesuatu kepada pemilik atau tempat asalnya.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: 'Alex received enthusiastic ______ from all the curators and visitors.'
quiz.explanation: 'Praise' (pujian apresiasi) adalah kata benda yang tepat.

takeaways: Mendalami kosakata apresiasi dan kehormatan: return, thank, celebrate, truth, honor, praise.
Menggunakan ungkapan formal perayaan dan rasa syukur (thanks to, it is an honor).
Menghargai nilai kejujuran, deduksi analitis, dan empati dalam menuntaskan persoalan.

Kamu harus menjadi tamu kehormatanku!' Petualangan Cerita 8: Festival Kota Tua siap dimulai!
